purpose: R169 commodity main-contract momentum mapped to HS300 upstream industries

data.membership_source: monthly r157 snapshots before 2020-12-31; daily r78 snapshots thereafter

method.factor: equal-weight commodity momentum z-score within mapped industry
method.ic: monthly cross-sectional Spearman rank IC among mapped HS300 members
method.long_short: industry equal-weight top3 minus bottom3, 0.30% round-trip cost

limitations: Sina main-continuous prices contain roll gaps; no per-contract back-adjustment was performed.
Industry mapping is static current THS L1 classification, not a point-in-time historical classification.
Only 7 upstream industries and about 15% of HS300 names are mapped.
Stock-level IC uses repeated industry signals; month-level win rate is the primary stability check.
Commodity inventory history starts around 2020-10-28 and was not used.
